cmpet8uo5000055xfnmce573y.summary: Handshake submission confirming the GH-mirror loop works end-to-end. No code action.

cmpetczrk0000i1g9wzvu9kct.summary: auth-trainer-login marked passing by @maaiz via the /qa thread. Status flipped in qa-state.json on 104133e reconciliation.

cmpetoriw00041izu94tf1z1w.summary: Form cues: added the elliptical entry that was the one library gap; getFormCues now returns a 3-line generic fallback instead of null for anything uncovered (covers custom-trainer exercises too); a TIP line surfaces the first cue inline above the set-input panel during an active workout so the cues aren't buried behind the FORM modal.

cmpettf57000012tc6hoflssb.summary: Slice 1/N — in-session superset: added a ⟳ PAIR button in the active-workout header that jumps directly into the customise screen with multi-select pre-enabled for the current day. User picks two+ exercises, taps ⟳ SUPERSET, comes back to the workout. Slice 2/N (next pass): in-session multi-select without exiting to customise.

cmpetwrb200001449vjxdat6z.summary: First-time exercises now pre-fill with a computed SUGGESTED weight × reps based on user bodyweight + a pattern table covering compound lifts, isolations, and bodyweight movements. A ★ SUGGESTED badge sits next to the inputs so the user knows to adjust. Already-logged exercises still use the historical lastSessionBest() pre-fill.

cmpeuo2ch0002ezwr2zs0zd0x.summary: Rest-timer scroll-jump bug fixed (scroll-y stashed in useRef so the unlock branch can restore the position after React fires the cleanup). Plus: new opt-in 'Auto-advance to next exercise after rest' setting in Settings → Workout Behaviour — default off, when on the next incomplete exercise auto-expands once rest ends. Otherwise stay-in-place is now the correct default behaviour.

cmpewcs3o0000vh3mw3at8fqw.summary: Removed the auto-advance Settings toggle per user feedback. Behaviour is now unconditional: stay on current exercise while incomplete sets remain, then auto-advance to next incomplete exercise once sets are done (or user skips/manually picks another). Deleted the ⚙ WORKOUT BEHAVIOUR card and the ironlog-auto-advance localStorage key.

cmpf74zdk000014bil8eji34j.summary: Multi-role support: User.extraRoles String[] field added so a single account can hold admin + trainer (etc) concurrently. Auth route returns it, userHasRole() helper checks both primary role and extras, trainer feature gates updated. Admin page exposes per-user + TRAINER / + ADMIN toggle chips next to the primary-role select.

cmpf76c900000rbocnbdnbdfi.summary: QA dashboard item card shows TESTED ×N + LAST <date time> in the status row (replaces the previous date-only). The notes blob is now rendered as a 📜 PATCH HISTORY list — each [date] line becomes its own row with the date tag highlighted. Latest activity is computed as max(item.lastTested, last comment ts) so a fresh submission moves the line forward even before the next QA pass.

cmpf77zl200005voyruidq5iz.summary: qa:scan now scans the 10 most-recent feature/pass sections in PATCHLOG (was 5). One-line change to scripts/qa-scan.ts.

cmpfhrafa0002ia3kom2bomak.summary: auth-register DOB box overflow fix — date input now strips WebkitAppearance + sets minWidth:0 + maxWidth:100% so iOS Safari's native picker chrome can't push the control past the form column.

cmpfhxexe0000tu25nol6i5tm.summary: auth-login passing confirmation from @Amanii. qa-state.json status flipped to passing.

cmpfhy0u00001tu250b5t20hc.summary: /qa comment form: NOTE is now optional when status=passing. Label switches to '(optional)' and the SAVE button enables without a note. Required for failing / retest / untested where a note is what makes the row actionable.

cmpfi6uvr0000soon43f81lvv.summary: auth-must-reset: admin force-reset now generates a temp password, hashes + saves it, returns the plaintext to the admin UI (copied to clipboard) so it can be shared with the user. Was previously only flipping mustResetPassword=true, leaving locked-out users unable to log in at all.

cmpflbdxk0000twp8lmz97l94.summary: /qa improvements: (1) sticky search box at top of viewport — stays accessible while scrolling. (2) RETEST status label renamed to 'PATCHED · RETEST' with the select option as 'Patched · please retest' so testers know an item flagged retest means 'attended, pending re-verification'. (3) Per-step comment threads deferred to next slice — currently each test gets one thread; surfacing per-step requires a richer comment schema.

cmpflemsg0000c3wg69m1q3ji.summary: Slice 1/N: target session duration field added to onboarding step 8 (30m / 45m / 60m / 90m+ chips) + persisted via UserProfile.targetSessionMinutes (Prisma migration). Slice 2 (next pass): planGenerator reads the field to tailor supersets/dropsets/HIIT for tighter windows.

cmpflv1h20000no0c3pc8ldt7.summary: /qa item-card title no longer ellipsis-clipped — wraps with wordBreak so long titles like 'Trainers see their athlete tier on Progress dashboard too' are fully readable on narrow phones.

cmpft67ov000014ir3w65jlri.summary: Welcome card tier pills rebuilt: Trainer + Athlete pills now sit on their own row beneath the username, each with a mini gradient progress bar to the next tier + '+N → NEXT' remaining-points readout. Top tier reads '★ TOP' instead. Score is the canonical headlineScore from computeAthleteTier.

cmpft7dwz000114irazgjg9ez.summary: Volume × Muscle 'core skipped' fix shipped earlier in 0e6722c (default-plan short ids like 'a7' for Hanging Leg Raises were silently failing the muscle lookup). The muscleMap now bridges WORKOUT_DATA short ids → primaryMuscles via lookupExMuscles(name). Hanging Leg Raises credits 'core' via fuzzy match on 'Hanging Leg Raise'.

cmpftk95500005l8al7u3wrgk.summary: Settings → edit profile DOB input: stripped iOS's native appearance, added minWidth:0 + maxWidth:100% + textAlign:left so it renders flush with the Height field above and never overflows the card.

cmpftlhti00015l8a5wx7qz3a.summary: Settings IDENTITY card 'Member since registration' → computed duration from User.createdAt. Shows 'Member for Xd / Xmo / Xy [Xmo]' or 'Joined today' for brand-new users.

cmpftonrn000011pawydh9g4i.summary: TierInfoModal now ships a '⚡ HOW TO EARN ATHLETE POINTS' section listing each of the 5 sub-ranks (Consistency, Strength, Volume, Mastery, Habits) with what feeds it AND the rough input that gets it to ~80. Plus a footnote on the diminishing-returns curve so the '+N PTS → next' number reads correctly.

cmpfu8ha10000nrnuy87cagh2.summary: Deferred IDEA: form previews + help text on warmup/cooldown/stretches AND treadmill incline % support. Logged for the next slice — current pass focused on the bug + critical UX items.

cmpfu9tb40000blb2zkfgvhs2.summary: Duplicate START workout prompts fix: tapping ▶ START WORKOUT on the home day-card expand now calls openDay() AND begin() immediately, skipping the workout-prep middle screen. The single intent = one tap to active workout.
